justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Pain education reduces catastrophizing and fear-avoidance; functional outcomes moderate when combined with movement.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 1-2 day workshop; low-moderate cost; multiple providers available; very accessible.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to virtually any patient with pain; cross-cutting utility across outpatient ortho, neuro, and chronic care.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Billed as therapeutic education; supports patient education CPT codes; no dedicated pain neuroscience billing code.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Growing employer interest; increasingly listed in chronic pain, outpatient ortho, and behavioral health rehab postings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients report relief from understanding their pain; reduces helplessness and catastrophizing.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Chronic pain patients pay cash, but PNE alone isn't a service consumers shop for — it's an adjunct.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Limited premium pricing; PNE is increasingly considered standard care, not a luxury offering.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Becoming commoditized — many PTs now claim PNE familiarity, eroding differentiation.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Protocolizable and teachable to associates; works well as a clinic-wide approach.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Public recognition is low; few patients seek out a 'PNE provider' by name.
justifications.business.efficiency: Short courses (often 1-2 days), inexpensive — very efficient to acquire.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Highly regarded in academic pain science circles; signals current evidence-based practice.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Strong and rapidly growing literature with prominent academic figures (Louw, Moseley).
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Core content in modern DPT pain curricula; very high curricular utility.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Substantial RCT and systematic review evidence, though effect sizes are modest as standalone treatment.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Increasingly preferred for faculty with pain or chronic-condition focus.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Short, inexpensive training with strong academic legitimacy — excellent ROI.
